causality: label at t uses only quotes in (t, t+L+H] for the outcome and quotes <= t for sigma/spread; never crosses a segment; label_end_ms = t + (L+H)*1000 is used for purge/embargo

families.fh: fixed-horizon net return: bid_exit - ask_entry (long), bid_entry - ask_exit (short), minus extra round-trip cost
families.opp: opportunity/NO_TRADE: cost-covering (kappa=2x) favourable excursion with adverse <= favourable/rho (rho=1) inside H
families.tb: triple barrier on the executable side (bid for long exits, ask for short exits), barrier = max(m*sigma*mid*sqrt(H), 3*spread)

grid.observation_time: bar end t_i (= feature row timestamp)

horizon_rationale.15: very short: 2x the 5 s micro window, ~100 ticks at the median 7.8 Hz; 1 s latency is still <7% of the horizon
horizon_rationale.300: medium-short: equals the 300 s feature window; upper end of an intended scalp, still ~2,300 ticks and well inside a segment
horizon_rationale.60: short: equals the 60 s feature window and ~470 ticks; typical 1-min move (~3.5 bps = ~140 points) is >10x the median spread
horizon_rationale.basis: observed tick rate, spread distribution (median 9 points) and feature timeframes - NOT historical profit
horizon_rationale.excluded: <15 s: below the 1 s grid/latency resolution relative to horizon; >300 s: not a scalp and cuts the number of independent samples

pre_registration.cost_reporting: every reported result must be shown under all three cost scenarios; unknown costs are never defaulted to zero
pre_registration.degeneracy_rule: a label whose NO_TRADE share is below 5% in a scenario is NON-INFORMATIVE as an abstain label there: it is reported, never used as primary, and never rescued by re-tuning its parameters

primary.basis: the only family whose NO_TRADE share is non-degenerate (45-82%) at every horizon and every cost scenario in the development-period label diagnostics; the middle horizon; selected from label balance only, no model or PnL result consulted

pre_registration.purpose: close the forking path: the label is NOT chosen from model results
pre_registration.secondary: all other candidates, reported as robustness; none may replace the primary without a new spec version

status: CANDIDATES - specified, diagnostics only; none selected; no model trained
tie_rules: same-second profit and stop -> stop first (conservative); both sides succeed in the same second -> NO_TRADE + ambiguous
